description: Before git push, gh pr create or gh release create, and before an MCP tool that opens a pull request, a merge request or a release, pushes files, writes a file or merges a pull request, verify the evidence the repository declares at HEAD. A failed check denies the call. A repository that declares nothing, neither at HEAD nor in the working tree, gets no decision, marked NOT MEASURED; every other case where nothing was verified asks. A push that changes the evidence rules against what the remote is known to hold is asked.

hooks.command: python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/proofbundle_gate.py" || { echo 'proofbundle gate: the gate could not run, so the call is blocked' >&2; exit 2; }
